newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cholet upgrades rating on Rhone-Poulenc.
newsitem.headline: Cholet upgrades rating on Rhone-Poulenc.

text.p: Brokerage Cholet Dupont on Monday raised its recommendation on stock in chemicals group Rhone-Poulenc to Buy from Accumulate.

Cholet-Dupont analyst Philippe Cottet said the rating change followed a study on the company which he considered underrated relative to other European chemicals and pharmaceuticals groups. He saw a potential upside in the stock of up to 20 percent.
The share was up 2.21 percent at 138.70 francs at 1440 GMT. The company was privatised three years ago at 135 francs per share.
